Episode details
Radio 5 Live,13 Nov 2026,55 mins
TCV: Commentating in the fog and can Kane be England's greatest?
Football Daily
Available for over a year
John Murray, Ian Dennis and Alistair Bruce-Ball back on a special night for Harry Kane at Wembley, as he scored the winner on his record-breaking 126th appearance for his country. They also speak to Adam Hassell of BBC Radio Nottingham about commentating in the fog at Altrincham v Notts County. And will Mauricio Pochettino be a success at Man Utd? We also have his week's Unintended Pub Name and chaos ensues as John and Ali take on Clash of the Commentators. TIMECODES 01:00 Harry Kane - England's greatest ever? 12:00 What to expect from Pochettino at Man Utd 18:00 BBC Radio Nottingham's Adam Hassell on commentating in the fog at Altrincham 30:00 This weekend's international footballl 34:20 Clash of the commentators 41:20 Unintended Pub Name 44:05 Great Glossary of Football Commentary 5 LIVE SPORT/BBC SOUNDS COMMENTARIES Friday 13th November NATIONS LEAGUE: Scotland v North Macedonia 1945 KO - LIVE ON SPORTS EXTRA Saturday 14th November NATIONS LEAGUE: Norway v Wales 1700 KO - LIVE ON SPORTS EXTRA WSL: Brighton v Liverpool 1715 KO - LIVE ON SPORTS EXTRA 2 NATIONS LEAGUE: Northern Ireland v Ukraine 1945 KO - LIVE ON SPORTS EXTRA Sunday 15th November WSL: Arsenal v London City Lionesses 1630 KO - LIVE ON SPORTS EXTRA NATIONS LEAGUE: Spain v England 1945 KO - LIVE ON 5 LIVE DIVISION ONE 10 men behind the ball 50p head Agricultural challenge, Back of the net, Back to square one, Backside and elbows, The Beautiful Game, Booked, Bosman, Bullet header, Buying a penalty, Caretaker manager, Channel of joy, Checked and cleared, Coupon buster, Cross-come-shot Cruyff Turn, Cultured/educated left foot, Dead-ball specialist, Draught excluder, Elastico/flip-flap, False nine, Fergie Time Fox in the box, Giving the goalkeeper the eyes, Grub hunter, Header Head like a biscuit tin, Head like a sheriff’s badge, Head tennis, Hibs it, In a good moment, In behind, Lollipop, Magic of the FA Cup, “Make sure you watch Match of the Day tonight” The Maradona, Need one to get in off their backside, Off their line, Olimpico, Onion bag, Panenka, Parachute payment, Park the bus, Perfect hat-trick, Postage stamp, Put his cap on it, Rabona, Roy of the Rovers stuff, Schmeichel-style, Scorpion kick, Spursy, Stick it in the mixer, Studs up Sweeper keeper, Taking it to the corner flag, Target man, Tiki-taka, Towering header, Trivela, UEFA penalty, Where the kookaburra sleeps, Where the owl sleeps, Where the spiders sleep, You could have two goalkeepers in there and they still wouldn’t have saved it.

פרק של פודקאסט הכדורגל עוסק בלילה המיוחד של הארי קיין באצטדיון וומבלי, שבו הבקיע את שער הניצחון בהופעתו ה-126 המהווה שיא לאומי עבור נבחרת אנגליה. הצוות דן בשאלה האם קיין הוא הגדול ששחקני אנגליה אי פעם.

בנוסף, הפודקאסט דן בציפיות ממוריסיו פוצ'טינו במנצ'סטר יונייטד, משוחח עם אדם האסל מרדיו BBC נוטינגהאם על חוויות שידור במשחק בתנאי ערפל כבדים בין אלטרינצ'אם לבין נוטס קאונטי, וסקירתו של מחזור המשחקים הבינלאומי הקרוב בליגת האומות ובסופרליג לנשים.
